description: TransModeler is Caliper Corporation's traffic simulation package for road networks from freeways to downtown areas and for wide-area multimodal networks. It simulates cars, trucks, buses, trains, bicycles, motorcycles and pedestrian impacts in a 2D or 3D GIS environment, models drivers' dynamic route choice from historical or simulated time-dependent travel times, takes origin-destination trip tables or turning movement volumes as demand, and offers hybrid simulation. It evaluates traffic signal and ITS operations such as electronic toll collection, route guidance and detection, supports vehicle classes with different levels of automation, can import Corsim and SimTraffic data, and integrates with the TransCAD demand model so simulation results can feed back into forecasting; TransModeler SE bundles microsimulation, traffic impact analysis and signal optimisation. Coverage is generic: any road network the user builds. Access: commercial Windows software sold by Caliper, with demos on request. Caveats: large networks need detailed input data and calibration, and licences are paid. It supports operational analysis of planned projects, capacity planning, incident and evacuation scenarios and traffic digital twins, and pairs with TransCAD, catalogued here.
